outcome: Give eCommerce teams a working Automated Return & Refund Fraud Detection capability on their own data — it reduces return-fraud losses and processing overhead.
overview: Return policy abuse lands directly on net margin, and the retailers it hurts most are usually those whose generous returns promise is a competitive asset they cannot withdraw. Automated Return & Refund Fraud Detection scores return and refund risk as events arrive, drawing on order and return history, refund patterns and account and device signals, so the small number of repeat abusers can be moved to modified terms while honest buyers keep a frictionless experience. A human reviewer applies every policy change; the model ranks and evidences the case only. Redington measures existing fraud losses and false-flag rates first, then proves the model on customer data across four to five weeks.
